question: Given $$A=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -1 \\ 0 & 3 & 2\end{bmatrix},\quad B=\begin{bmatrix}2 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 \\ 3 & -2\end{bmatrix},$$ calculate $AB$.
explanation:
Compatibility for multiplication
$A$ is of order $2\times3$ and $B$ is of order $3\times2$, so $AB$ is defined and has order $2\times2$.
Row-column products
$$AB=\begin{bmatrix}1(2)+2(1)+(-1)(3) & 1(1)+2(0)+(-1)(-2) \\ 0(2)+3(1)+2(3) & 0(1)+3(0)+2(-2)\end{bmatrix}$$
Simplification
$$AB=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 3 \\ 9 & -4\end{bmatrix}$$
